facts.fact: Minister Sofiene Hemissi says the Khadamet mobile app, launched end August 2026, gives access to more than forty administrative services through digital identity.

Digital identity is used across more than forty services in Khadamet, and MobileID also gives access to the Portail du citoyen for birth-extract translation requests (Interior Ministry, 31 August 2026).
The Interior Ministry presented a remote service on the Portail du citoyen reached through the MobileID digital identity on 31 August 2026.

TUN.note: No link between civil register and ID stated.
No government payments to people stated.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.
Nothing on the national ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.
No local government office connection stated.
Municipal tax e-payment is only announced, with no record system stated.
No survey of account holding stated.
No mobile money or retail payment service stated.

facts.fact: Minister Hemissi announced on 6 November 2026 that electronic payment of municipal taxes in some municipalities and remote tax filing for individuals will launch before end 2026.
